description: This file contains a script and class for updating test expectations based on builder bot results, including logic for parsing, analyzing, and modifying test expectation lines, and interacting with build results and dashboards.

classes.name: RemoveFlakesOMatic
classes.description: A class responsible for analyzing test expectations, determining which lines can be removed based on builder bot results, and updating the expectations file accordingly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes the process, parses arguments, and triggers the update of test expectations.

methods.name: _can_delete_line
methods.description: Determines if a specific test expectation line can be safely removed based on builder results and expectations.

methods.name: _has_pass_expectation
methods.description: Checks if 'PASS' is among the expectations for a test.

methods.name: _expectations_that_were_met
methods.description: Returns the set of expectations that are reflected in the actual test results.

methods.name: _has_unstrippable_expectations
methods.description: Checks if expectations contain unremovable expectations like 'REBASELINE' or 'SKIP'.

methods.name: _get_builder_results_by_path
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary of test results for each builder.

methods.name: _remove_associated_comments_and_whitespace
methods.description: Removes comments and whitespace associated with a test expectation line if it is being removed.

methods.name: _expectations_to_remove
methods.description: Computes and caches the list of expectation lines that are eligible for removal.

methods.name: get_updated_test_expectations
methods.description: Returns a TestExpectations object with passing lines removed based on builder results.

methods.name: show_removed_results
methods.description: Opens a dashboard in the web browser to review the removed test expectation lines.

methods.name: write_test_expectations
methods.description: Writes the updated test expectations back to the filesystem.
